description: This file defines SignatureSourcer, a Java class that extends SignatureVisitor. It is used to generate Java source code representations from signatures, particularly for generics, method signatures, class types, and related signatures within Java bytecode analysis. The class handles formal type parameters, return types, parameters, superclasses, and inner class types, using ASM library components.

classes.name: SignatureSourcer
classes.description: A custom implementation of SignatureVisitor that generates Java source code equivalent for signatures involving generics and types, capturing formal type parameters, class types, method parameters, return types, and superclasses.

methods.name: getReturnType
methods.description: Returns the SignatureSourcer instance representing the return type of the signature being processed.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Returns the list of SignatureSourcer instances representing the method parameters.

methods.name: hasFormalsContent
methods.description: Indicates if the signature has collected any formal type parameters.

methods.name: formalsToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of formal type parameters.

methods.name: getSuperClass
methods.description: Returns the SignatureSourcer instance representing the superclass signature.
